text_block_list.text:
One evening, Т.М. Опера О and I are
walking
around the shopping district...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Look ahead. A crowd has
gathered...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Do you think it's a duel? If so, I must
intercede.
Or perhaps—should I enter
the fray?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We go and take a look. Just as I
thought, there's
no duel going on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
How about you? The prima donna over
there!
Care to try your luck?
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! I suppose I have no choice
now that
I've been singled out among
the audience.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A raffle is it? How amusing. I'm
absolutely
fascinated with this spinning
gadget you have
here.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, pluck that ticket from your
breast
pocket. And obviously, only use
your index and
middle fingers.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's always a performance, even in the
way one
pulls something from a pocket...
I take out the
ticket as she asks and give
it to the clerk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Time to start the show, Trainer. Take
hold of the
gadget's lever with me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For the moment of truth! Spin, O gears
of fate!
Haaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Both of us raise one hand to the sky and
turn the
raffle spinner with the other.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
spinner's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! 'Tis a ray of light from the
heavens!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The grand-prize! Indeed, even the
Goddess of
Luck is enamored with the
star that I am.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Aaah ha ha haaa!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A hot spring vacation? How delightful. I
would
dare depart this instant, if only I
could.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But, alas, it's not in the cards while I still
walk the
Overlord's path.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes. As I traverse this path, I should
entertain no
other.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If only the hot spring would come to me!
Should it
not rush to my feet the
moment I beckon?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Truly? They're surprisingly
unaccommodating.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Then nothing can be done. I'll entrust
you with
the ticket for now.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Close it with wax using the king's seal
and keep it
safe until the appropriate
time comes.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And now the hot spring vacation ticket is
in my
possession.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hehehe... Can you see it? Because
I most
definitely can!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
At the summit of the Overlord's path... is
a hot
spring! Flowing freely from the
very earth! Haaah
ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hah, first-prize!  Luck certainly loves me.
Even I, a
king of kings, am pleased by
this!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But wait! Could it be?! The holy sword
before us is
none other than...
Excaliburger!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Behold! A single carrot stands plunged
into the
stone of minced meat!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Only one worthy to rule is capable of
withdrawing
it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Which means I have not a moment to
lose. We
must make haste to the
kitchen!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I am prepared! Are you ready, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Once I draw the carrot, you are to say
the words
of revelation. Understood?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ready... Pop!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Behold my glory! Haaah ha ha! Munch, munch...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This holy sword... is delicious! Truly a
treat for the
royal taste buds!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmn, second-prize. I typically fare
better than
this. And yet...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Look at them all! With a little love from
me, they
would make great appreciation
gifts for my
adorning fans.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect! Young boy over there, I
bestow unto
thee a carrot.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Eww... Keep it. I hate carrots.
text_block_list.name: Boy

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Whatever do you mean?
This is no
ordinary carrot, but a loving
gift from yours truly.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Now I really don't want it...
text_block_list.name: Boy

text_block_list.text: Y-young boy! Wait!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How could this be? Ah! I see now. One
taste of
this carrot and all other foods
would be rendered
unpalatable.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I cannot hold out any longer!
Trainer, we
must eat all the carrots
ourselves.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A ballet of carrots, je t'aime! We shall all
dance
the dance of carrots together!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What? A single carrot?! How dare you
insult
royalty!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What do you have to say for yourself,
carrot?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She vents her anger to the carrot. Of
course, it
has no response.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have no other choice than to sing a
ballad of
sorrow, repurposing the carrot
as a microphone.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's times like this that make you sulk in
your
sorrows, don a different mantel,
and sing the
blues. Hit it, band!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ahhh, yes! Uh-huh! Mhmmm!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Welcooome to the carrot kingdooom!
You
carotene soldier, un deux trois!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, woe... Worse has come to worst. The
great
me... recipient of a consolation
prize?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
To think I would receive nothing more
than a
mere packet of tissue paper...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Notice how I say "tissue paper" and not simply "tissue." The former has a more beautiful ring to it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Trainer! I issue a royal decree!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Take this packet of tissue paper and
exchange it
for a hot spring vacation
ticket!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: There's no way they'd go for that...

text_block_list.text:
I will not hear your whining. Tragedy has
befallen
me, and I have become the mad
king, the Raving
Lord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If you fail, I will confine you to
imprisonment in la
Conciergerie!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
With a hot spring vacation to look
forward to,
Opera O's motivation shoots
through the roof!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A bad luck of the draw has changed the
king. It
doesn't seem like anything is
going to improve
her mood.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O devours Excaliburger, content
with both
the flavor and how much fun it
is to eat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We eat the carrots while performing
some weird
choreography. The taste is
nothing to write home
about, but they're
good all the same.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O sings with desperation, but the
kids
around the shops seem to like her
song.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
